server.deliverableRegister.disabled: Deliverable register fields are unavailable while their feature is disabled.

ui.deliverableRegister.patternConflict: The project changed. Your pattern and original version are retained; reload the current settings before retrying.

ui.deliverableRegister.noUndated: No open undated deliverables match the current filters.
ui.deliverableRegister.noDated: No dated open deliverables match the current filters.
ui.deliverableRegister.dateScope: Open deliverables in the current filter scope. Issued, Accepted and Cancelled are excluded.
ui.deliverableRegister.rangeExcludes: A due-date range excludes undated deliverables. Remove that range explicitly to include them.
